welcome_to_indodhobi_please_read_these_t: Welcome to IndoDhobi. Please read these Terms of Service carefully before booking laundry, dry cleaning, or steam pressing services through our web application or mobile portals.
by_accessing_our_platform_or_placing_an_: By accessing our platform or placing an order, you agree to be bound by these Terms and our Privacy Policy. You must be at least 18 years of age and legally competent to enter into binding contracts under the Indian Contract Act, 1872.
pickups_and_deliveries_are_scheduled_wit: Pickups and deliveries are scheduled within designated time slots (e.g. 10:00 AM - 01:00 PM). Our verified doorstep rider will contact you prior to arrival.
to_ensure_chain_of_custody_security_you_: To ensure chain-of-custody security, you must provide the 4-digit Pickup OTP displayed on your order screen to the rider. The rider will count and seal your laundry bag with a tamper-evident physical Bag Tag ID.
standard_turnaround_time_is_48_hours_fro: Standard turnaround time is {{home.turnaroundHours}} hours from successful pickup. Express {{config.expressTurnaroundHours}}-hour turnaround is available for selected services subject to express surcharge.
handover_requires_sharing_the_4_digit_de: Handover requires sharing the 4-digit Delivery OTP. Please inspect the sealed package upon delivery.
while_indodhobi_employs_commercial_grade: While IndoDhobi employs commercial-grade German steam machinery and fabric-safe hypoallergenic detergents, the following terms govern garment handling:
any_tears_missing_buttons_color_runs_or_: Any tears, missing buttons, color runs, or stubborn pre-existing stains observed during doorstep pickup or plant audit will be logged with photographic evidence and customer notification.
customers_are_solely_responsible_for_emp: Customers are solely responsible for emptying all garment pockets before pickup. IndoDhobi is not liable for money, jewelry, electronics, or pens left inside clothes.
silks_pure_wool_pashminas_hand_embroider: Silks, pure wool, pashminas, hand-embroidered sarees, and wedding lehengas must be booked under the designated "Dry Clean & Delicate" category. IndoDhobi will adhere to standard manufacturer wash-care tags.
all_service_rates_are_published_per_garm: All service rates are published per garment. Applicable GST at {{config.gstPercentage}}% is calculated on the order total at checkout. GST Tax Invoices are downloadable from your account portal.
for_cod_orders_payment_is_due_upon_doors: For COD orders, payment is due upon doorstep delivery. You may pay the assigned rider via physical Cash or by scanning the Official Company Dynamic UPI QR code. A 12-digit UPI reference (UTR) is verified on digital settlements.
orders_under_399_incur_a_standard_pickup: Orders under ₹{{config.freeDeliveryThreshold}} incur a standard pickup & delivery fee of ₹{{config.deliveryFee}}. Orders of ₹{{config.freeDeliveryThreshold}} and above receive 100% Free Doorstep Delivery.
orders_may_be_cancelled_free_of_charge_a: Orders may be cancelled free of charge at any time before clothes are picked up from your doorstep (in "Booked" or "Pickup Assigned" stage). Once clothes are picked up and sealed with a Bag Tag, cancellations cannot be processed.
for_cancelled_orders_where_payment_was_p: For cancelled orders where payment was prepaid online, a 100% full refund is initiated within 2 business hours back to the original source payment method (bank account / UPI / credit card), reflecting within 3-5 banking days. For COD orders, the order is cancelled with zero charge.

per_article_whichever_is_lower_upon_prov: per article (whichever is lower), upon provision of an original purchase receipt and verified inspection audit.
